# Pixel Tasks

An offline, pixel-style task list built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No storage, no network — all state lives in memory for the current session.

## Features

- Add tasks via the **Add** button or by pressing Enter.
- Input is trimmed; blank input is ignored.
- Total task count shown in `#todo-total`, incomplete count in `#remaining` (both start at 0).
- Each task gets a text span, checkbox and delete button with incrementing numeric IDs (`#todo-text-1`, `#todo-check-1`, `#todo-delete-1`, …).
- Toggling a checkbox updates the incomplete count and strikes through the text.
- Deleting removes the task and updates both counts.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Files

- `index.html` — markup and structure
- `style.css` — pixel-themed styling, responsive down to 360px
- `app.js` — in-memory task logic

## Accessibility

All controls are keyboard-accessible with visible focus states and labeled inputs/buttons.
